reviews.review: Dont believe the negative reviews its just people with nostalgia about the trilogy not understanding this takes place way in to the future past the trilogy. Its not the same timeline or characters and never was meant to be.
Classic game, aged well in my opinion. Not as good as the original trilogy to be sure, but a fun spinoff nonetheless. Multiplayer is horde based and active still.

Bad Mass Effect is still better than no Mass Effect. Still, I can’t get my head around why the main protagonist, who is supposed to be saving the galaxy, looks like she still needs her mom to wipe her ass.

I never played it when it first came out. Finally decided to give it a try and it was better than I excepted but still just kind of mid. I did not at first think that the lack of the Paragon Renegade system from the previous games would be that big of a deal. But it feels like you don't have any real control over who the main character is. The NPCs just say what they have to say and you can be a bit snarky but thats about it. The main story is fine as far as I got but I don't really feel like im missing out on anything dropping the game after 20 hours.

As far as postives for the game the combat is quite fun. The driving has its moments but its not the M35 Mako and the Nomad is less of a tank and more of a glorified taxi. Looks pretty cool though. Otherwise the game looks good. Although I did have to change the look of the main character and their twin, just something uncanny about the way they both look.

I did not finish this game as it crashed continuously on a boss fight about 20 hours into the game. Tried two different computers and the usual fixs and nothing worked the game just crashed at different points in the fight. Disapointing alot of bugs were never fixed. The most obvious but is how npcs are randomly floating off the ground in cutsceenes. Or how if your NPC followers are not right next to you their voicelines become whispers you can bairly hear if at all. At this point its fair to say alot of bugs in this game will never be fixed.

I wouldn't recommend it, but its not as bad as I expected.
